questions.question: Name the steps of the data cycle in order.
questions.expected_answer: Pose a question, collect the data, organise the data, represent it, analyse it, and report the findings. The report can lead to a new question.

questions.question: A category has two bundles of five tally marks and three single marks. What is its frequency? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Each bundle is 5, so two bundles are 10. Add the 3 single marks: 10 plus 3 is 13. The frequency is 13.

questions.question: Order the transport results from smallest to largest: walk 17, taxi 9, bus 6, car 5, bicycle 3.
questions.expected_answer: From smallest to largest: bicycle 3, car 5, bus 6, taxi 9, walk 17.
